title: Fray waivers
description: Accepted-risk register kept in the customer repo at .fray/waivers.yml. Each entry waives one open finding (rule + address). The client resolves the address to a DFD id and POSTs only id, rule_id, target_id, and expires. Reason and owner never leave the repository. Ids must not contain personal data.

id.description: Stable customer id; must not contain personal data (no names, emails, logins).

reason.description: Justification; stays in the repository and is never sent to Fray.

owner.description: Team or GitHub handle as text; stays in the repository and is never sent to Fray.

expires.description: UTC calendar date YYYY-MM-DD. Server enforces 365-day (90-day for high) horizons.
